$comment: OpenClaw is an UPSTREAM RUNTIME DEPENDENCY of SairiOS. Its source is never
vendored into this repository. This file pins the version SairiOS expects,
so the image build, the agent bridge and CI all agree on one target.
`status` is deliberately honest, and the three values mean different things:
unpinned - no version chosen.
pinned   - a version is chosen and its published CLI surface has been read,
but SairiOS has not been run against a live gateway of it.
verified - a maintainer has run SairiOS against a live gateway of exactly
this version and reconciled the frame shapes in
services/agent-bridge/src/providers/openclaw.ts.
`make doctor` prints this status, and the agent bridge includes it in its
provider report.

package.name: openclaw
$comment: The guest runs Node 22.23.2 (pinned in vm/cloud-init/user-data.yaml),
which satisfies the first range. Bumping either pin means rechecking
this constraint: OpenClaw refuses to start on an unsupported runtime.
services/agent-bridge/src/setup.ts drives `openclaw onboard` with the
flags documented at that source. They have been read, not executed here.
The first machine to run first-run setup is the first execution.
Split status, because the two halves are not equally known.
VERIFIED against a live gateway of exactly this version: the envelope
(req/res/event), the connect.challenge -> connect -> hello-ok handshake,
protocol version 4, the client id/mode enums, and the request/response
cycle. Real captured frames are committed at
services/agent-bridge/src/providers/gateway-frames.fixture.json and the
tests run on them.
NOT VERIFIED: a full agent turn. Running one needs a configured model
provider, which needs a user's API key. sessions.create/send and the
session.* events exist in the vocabulary hello-ok advertised, but their
params and payload shapes have not been observed.
Found on the way: the protocol.md shipped inside the openclaw package
shows client.mode: 'operator' in its connect example. That value is not
in the enum and the gateway refuses it. operator is a ROLE.

requiredCapabilitiesFromGateway: tool-call events carrying a SairiOS capability name
a channel for returning a SairiUI document

$comment: SairiOS never writes into OpenClaw's credential store. It writes ONE
0600 environment file and onboards OpenClaw with --secret-input-mode ref,
so OpenClaw stores {source:'env', id:'<VAR>'} and resolves the value at
run time from the environment systemd hands it. The key is never an
argv element, never logged, and never returned by any HTTP route.
